options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: enabled_sports
options.description:
Choose which sports to enable

NOTE: You can still do Behemoth without all the 4 main sports enabled however
Behemoth King **requires** Sports Mix enabled

options.name: include_tournaments
options.description: Include tournament locations and items

options.name: include_exhibition
options.description: Include exhibition locations and items

options.name: start_with_sports
options.description:
Start with 4 sports? HEAVILY RECOMMENDED
Will cause immediate BK if off and you DON'T have any party modes given at the start.

options.name: start_with_mushroom_cup
options.description:
Start with Mushroom Cup for Basketball, Dodgeball, Volleyball and Hockey?
(Also unlocks related courts) - Recommended if you don't have party games on!

options.name: cup_unlock_type
options.description:
How to unlock cups

**Cup Item**: Each cup is its own item
**Progressive Cup**: Cups are unlocked in a certain order with progressive items. (Normal -> Hard (If enabled) ->
Sports Mix)
Note: Progressive Cup will unlock the cup for **every** sport while Cup Item has cups for each sport

options.name: court_unlock_type
options.description:
How to unlock courts

**Court Item**: Each court is its own item
**Progressive Court**: Courts are unlocked in a certain order with progressive items
Note: Behemoth Stage is an item! Behemoth Stage is the last court unlocked in Progressive Court

options.name: start_with_characters
options.description: Start with 2 or 3 random characters

options.name: exhibition_type
options.description:
What type of exhibition locations do you want?

**All Sports**: Exhibition locations will be for all the 4 main sports
**Universal**: Exhibition locations will be for **any** sport

options.name: exhibition_difficulties
options.description:
Which exhibition difficulties should be included?
If the difficulty is off, you won't be able to send checks with that difficulty
(Easy, Normal, Hard, Expert)

options.name: hard_tournament_difficulty
options.description:
Would you like to include locations and items for Hard Tournaments?
Adds 3 Progressive Cups to the pool if Progressive Cup Item is selected

options.name: sports_mix_unlock
options.description: Unlock Sports Mix by getting the Sports Mix item or the 4 Sports Crystals

options.name: trap_chance
options.description: The chance a filler is swapped with a trap

options.name: score_sanity
options.description: (NOT WORKING) Toggle on or off score sanity

options.name: score_sanity_points
options.description: (NOT WORKING) Every number of points will send a check

options.name: score_sanity_max
options.description: (NOT WORKING) Score Sanity will go up to this number of points

options.name: basket_time
options.description: Select the custom amount of time for a Basketball tournament

options.name: enable_b_points_win
options.description: Getting a certain amount of points wins you or the opponent the set

options.name: b_points_win
options.description:
Set the required amount of points to win
NOTE: The requirement for Bowser Jr. Blvd. is (value x 5) + 50 rounded
to the nearest 1 decimal place

options.name: b_period
options.description:
How many periods do you want to be playing?
Recommended to set a low amount, kinda boring otherwise.

options.name: dodge_time
options.description: Select the custom amount of time for a Dodgeball tournament

options.name: d_period
options.description:
How many periods do you want to be playing?
Recommended to set a low amount, kinda boring otherwise.

options.name: d_max_health
options.description: How much health should everyone have?

options.name: v_points_win
options.description:
Set the required amount of points to win
NOTE: The requirement for Bowser Jr. Blvd. is value x 2 rounded
to the nearest 1 decimal place

options.name: v_period
options.description:
How many sets do you want to be playing?
Recommended to set a low amount, kinda boring otherwise.

options.name: hockey_time
options.description: Select the custom amount of time for a Hockey tournament

options.name: enable_h_points_win
options.description: Getting a certain amount of points wins you or the opponent the set

options.name: h_points_win
options.description:
Set the required amount of points to win
NOTE: The requirement for Bowser Jr. Blvd. is (value x 5) + 50 rounded
to the nearest 1 decimal place

options.name: h_period
options.description:
How many periods do you want to be playing?
Recommended to set a low amount, kinda boring otherwise.

options.name: goal_condition
options.description:
What is your goal?

**Defeat Behemoth**: Defeat the Behemoth to goal!
**Defeat Behemoth King**: Defeat the Behemoth King to goal!
**Win Cups**: Win a certain amount of cups to goal!
**Exhibition Tour**: Win every exhibition match for your selected difficulties to goal! (Needs All Sports option)
**Party Palooza**: Win every game in every Party Mode to goal!

NOTE: Exhibition Tour disables the QoL feature for winning exhibition matches, recommended to have 2 difficulties
selected

options.name: win_cups_amount
options.description: How many cups are required to goal?

options.name: boss_locations
options.description:
Have locations behind bosses even if your goal isn't that boss!
Cannot be the same as the goal condition!

options.name: behemoth_hp
options.description:
Behemoth Health - 2400 is default
Recommended to edit this in the YAML (2400 - 4000)

options.name: behemoth_king_hp
options.description:
Behemoth King Health - 3000 is default
Recommended to edit this in the YAML (3000 - 7000)

options.name: party_mode
options.description:
Which (if any) Party Modes do you want enabled?
(Feed Petey, Harmony Hustle, Bob-omb Dodge, Smash Skate)

NOTE: All are required if your goal is Party Palooza

options.name: start_with_party_modes
options.description:
Start with the enabled party modes
Useful if you're not starting with the sports!

options.name: party_mode_opponent
deathlink
options.description:
When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
Toggleable inside client

options.name: deathlink_action
options.description:
What counts as sending a deathlink? Requires Deathlink on

NOTE: Every number of points works like normal for everything BUT dodgeball.
In dodgeball, everytime the opponent wins the set a deathlink triggers

options.name: deathlink_consequence
options.description: What happens when you receive a deathlink? Requires Deathlink on

options.name: deathlink_opponent_scores_points
options.description:
How many points should the opponent get to send a deathlink?
Requires Deathlink on & Every Number Of Points action

options.name: deathlink_opponent_get_points
options.description:
How many points should the opponent get when receiving a deathlink?
Requires Deathlink on & Opponent Gains Point consequence

options.name: deathlink_boss_health_recovered
options.description:
What percentage of the boss' health should be recovered when sent a deathlink?
(Behemoth & Behemoth King)

options.name: deathlink_dodgeball_health_lost
options.description:
**ONLY FOR DODGEBALL**
How much health will you lose when you get sent a deathlink if you're in dodgeball?

options.name: character_sanity
options.description:
Turn on or off Character Sanity
(Winning with a character and/or costume sends a check)

options.name: send_both_character_sanity
options.description:
When winning with a costume, send the Character Sanity
check for *both* the character and the costume or just the costume

options.name: court_sanity
options.description: Winning on each court sends a check

options.name: special_sanity
options.description: Using each character's special sends a check

options.name: local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: non_local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: start_inventory
options.description: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: "Bomb: 1"

options.name: start_hints
options.description: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: start_location_hints
options.description: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
